title: Calculator Display and Number Entry
user_story: As a user, I want to see a clear display area and number buttons (0-9), so that I can easily enter numbers for my calculations.
acceptance_criteria: The web page loads with an empty or zero-initialized display area at the top.
Clicking any number button (0-9) appends that digit to the current input in the display.
The display updates immediately after each click without requiring a full page refresh.

title: Perform Addition, Subtraction, Multiplication, and Division
user_story: As a user, I want to select an arithmetic operator between numbers, so that I can compute the result of basic math operations.
acceptance_criteria: Clicking an operator button (+, -, *, /) records the current input as the first operand and prepares for the second.
The display clears or shows a placeholder after selecting an operator to indicate readiness for the next number.
Pressing the equals button calculates the result using the selected operator and displays it accurately.

title: Clear Input and Reset Calculator
user_story: As a user, I want a clear button to erase my current input or reset the entire calculation, so that I can correct mistakes or start fresh without reloading the page.
acceptance_criteria: A 'Clear' (C) button is visible on the interface.
Clicking 'Clear' resets the display to zero and removes any pending operators or operands.
The calculator returns to its initial ready state after clearing, allowing immediate new input.

title: Handle Invalid Operations Gracefully
user_story: As a user, I want to see an error message when attempting to divide by zero, so that I understand the operation is invalid without breaking the app.
acceptance_criteria: Attempting to calculate division with zero as the second operand displays a clear 'Error' or 'Cannot divide by zero' message in the display area.
The calculator remains functional after showing an error, allowing the user to clear and try again.
No browser crashes or unhandled exceptions occur when this edge case is triggered.
